title: Sahih Muslim
author: muslim-ibn-al-hajjaj
attributionNote: The compiler selected, arranged and in places commented on the reports; the reports themselves are attributed within each text to their transmitters. The catalogue distinguishes the compiler's work from the material compiled.
description: Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj's collection of sound reports, arranged by topic and with the variants of each report gathered together. Its introduction is one of the earliest surviving treatises on the criticism of transmitters.
historicalContext: Compiled at Nishapur in the second half of the ninth century. With al-Bukhari's collection it forms the pair Sunni tradition regards as the most reliable after the Qur'an.
availabilityNote: Streamed section by section from the Hadith API at read time, Arabic beside the English translation. The English translation is the one the API serves under Abdul Hamid Siddiqui's name. Its rights remain with the translator or his publisher; the text is streamed from the host, not relicensed.
